name: El Portal Village Council

meetings.pattern: Fourth Tuesday of every month except August, 7:00 p.m., Village Hall, 500 NE 87th Street, El Portal, FL 33138. The posted November and December 2026 dates move off the fourth Tuesday for the holidays.

schedule.note: Village Council Meeting (third Tuesday, as posted)
Village Council Meeting (second Tuesday, as posted)

phases.name: Budget workshop on the administration's proposed budget
phases.decides: Council reviews the proposed 2026-27 budget from the administration, 5:30 p.m. at Village Hall. The proposed (maximum) millage was set at a late-July council session for the TRIM notice.

phases.name: First budget hearing
phases.decides: Tentative millage rate and tentative annual operating budget ($5,257,909) for FY 2026-27, Thursday 6:30 p.m.

phases.name: Second and final budget hearing
phases.decides: Final millage rate and final annual operating budget for FY 2026-27, 6:45 p.m., preceded by a special assessment budget meeting at 6:30 p.m. and followed by the regular council meeting at 7:00 p.m.

phases.name: Fiscal year begins
phases.decides: FY 2026-27 budget takes effect. The agenda labels the year '2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR'; the October 1 start is the Florida municipal standard and is not stated on a fetchable village page.

phases.name: August recess
phases.decides: No regular council meeting in August.

phases.name: Village general election
phases.decides: Mayor and Council Seats 1, 2, 3 and 4 are all on the ballot.

levers.how: Speak during the Good and Welfare item at the regular council meeting at Village Hall.
levers.rules: The agenda asks that comments be limited to three minutes per person and that speakers keep to agenda items. No profanity, shouting, heckling or disruptive behavior; no signs or placards in Village Hall. No sign-up procedure is printed.

levers.how: No written comment procedure is published. Email the Village Clerk, Yenise Jacobi, at yjacobi@villageofelportal.org and ask that it go to the council.
levers.deadline: Council packets go out by close of business Friday before the meeting, so send comments before then to reach the packet

levers.how: Each council member has a page with a direct email and phone (for example Mayor Omarr Nickerson, onickerson@villageofelportal.org, 305-338-2730). Village Hall main line 305-795-7880.
Submit the Public Records Request Form to the Village Clerk, who responds to requests.

Charter amendment by petition is available under state law: a petition signed by 10 percent of the registered electors as of the last municipal general election forces a referendum at the next general election or a special election.
levers.rules: Fla. Stat. 166.031(1). The village charter's own initiative section, if any, could not be read: the village site does not post the charter and municode.com (fl/el_portal) returned errors to automated fetching.

levers.how: Not found. The charter was not readable (see petition); only the state charter-amendment referendum route under Fla. Stat. 166.031 is confirmed.

Recall follows Florida's uniform municipal recall statute, which applies to every city whether or not its charter has a recall section. For a village with 500 to 1,999 registered electors the first petition needs the greater of 100 electors or 10 percent, gathered within 30 days; for 2,000 to 4,999, the greater of 250 or 10 percent. A second 'Recall Petition and Defense' round needs 15 percent within 60 days.
levers.rules: Fla. Stat. 100.361(1), (2)(b), (2)(f), (3)(a), (3)(c), (11), (12). File with the Village Clerk. El Portal's elector count was not checked; pick the tier from county registration figures.
levers.deadline: 30 days for the first round; 60 days for the second

levers.how: File with the Village Clerk, who is the Supervisor of Elections and official filing officer. The 2026 qualifying dates were not posted on the election page.
Vote November 3, 2026 for Mayor and all four council seats. Vote-by-mail request forms are linked from the village site.
levers.rules: Registered voters living in the village.

levers.how: The village has a Planning and Zoning board that meets as needed at Village Hall; council committee assignments are posted. No application page was found.

elections.terms: Mayor and four council seats; all five are on the November 3, 2026 ballot. Term length is not stated on a fetchable village page and the charter could not be read; the county municipality directory lists the next election as November 2026.

notes: Checked 2026-10-22. Schedule: the village meetings page lists Oct 27, Nov 17 and Dec 8, 2026 and nothing for 2027; the 2026 calendar PDF has no readable text. agendaLeadDays is 4 because the clerk page says council packets are distributed by close of business Friday before a Tuesday meeting; the agenda itself may post earlier or later. Budget dates are from the posted agendas. Charter not read: the village does not post it and municode.com (library.municode.com/fl/el_portal) returned errors, so initiative, referendum and recall charter sections, term lengths, and the qualifying period are missing; recall and petition levers use state statutes. The election page lists the Nov 3, 2026 candidates but no qualifying dates or runoff rule. Public comment three-minute limit is from the printed agenda (phrased as a request). Video page exists but was not checked.
